I never thought about the red backlight. Doesn't red have to be brighter for the same perceived light value? I read my first gen kindle next to bed with a yellowish bulb. I never thought of a red time to go to bed lamp

The reason for the red is circadian rhythm. In particular, humans seem to "reset" their clock by the bluish light of sunrise and sunset. You keep looking at bluish light long after sunset, you'll fool your body into thinking that it somehow got the time wrong and it's still sunset - which, of course, ends up with your internal clock offset from the real thing. Oversimplifying of course, but meh.

Red light in particular does not do that. Even if it is brighter. Yellow, the same thing, to a lesser extent. (One of the problems with moving away from incandescent bulbs, although that is another matter.)

Hey guys I saw that awesome nutter butter recipe and figured I'd share my extremely simple, yet mad potent firecracker recipe. They don't taste good, they don't taste horrible, but they will get you over the moon. The best part about this recipe is IT WILL NOT STINK UP YOUR KITCHEN, I swear to god it smells like you're baking cookies, so feel free to cook it at home when you have a few hours to yourself. Quickly want to point at that I got the main part of my recipe from this guy: http://boards.cannabis.com/threads/how-to-make-plain-ol-perfect-working-firecrackers.87246/ so kudos to him.

Preheat your oven to 320F before you do anything else :)

Ingredients

  • Graham Crackers - It says you can use other types, but stick with graham, taste the best, easiest to use. I go with honey or cinnamon if you wanna get crazy. You will need 1 full cracker per firecracker you want to make.

  • Canola oil (Veggie will work)

  • Nutella - The recipe says you can use peanut butter and stuff... I've tried it all, nutella works the best (and tastes). If you MUST use peanut butter, make sure its super organic. The kind that gets all liquidy up top.

  • Tin foil

  • Bud - Grind up your best chronic. The finer the better. If you have a mortar and pestle and can turn that shit into dust you are in for the ride of your life. The finer you grind it, the better the thc will absorb into the nutella, also the less chunks of plant matter you'll be eating. The amount per firecracker is up to your discretion. When I was just a pup, the first time I ever had an edible I ate one of these babies with .33 on it. I was easily a [10] and I ate it right before an after school high school event. WORST.IDEA.EVER

Instructions

There are 2 ways to make them. If this is your first time I suggest you take the easier way. The hard way will make it more potent, but will also leave you with a higher chance of fucking up if you don't know what you're doing because you used too much nutella or canola oil.

Easy Way (No Canola Oil): 1. Break the graham cracker in half so you have 2 halves.

  1. Spead nutella on one side of each cookie. I don't have a measurement for you but its not a lot. Enough to cover the cookie but also when you make a sandwhich with the other cookie, the nutella won't drip out.

  2. Spread your ground on chronic on top of the nutella, make sure its as spread out as possible, you don't want it sitting on top of itself or it won't absorb as well.

  3. Place them on a microwavable plate

  4. Repeat for all firecrackers necessary

  5. Take your plate and microwave on high for exactly 15 seconds

  6. Press the two nutella sides together GENTLY

  7. Wrap each firecracker in tinfoil, making sure no part of the cookie is exposed. You want that thing to congeal.

  8. Bake on a cookie sheet for exactly 22 minutes. This part is critical.

  9. Let them sit for about 10 minutes still in the foil

  10. Unwrap them carefully

  11. Place them back in the microwave for another 15 seconds (NO FOIL)

  12. Eat all the nutella that leaked out into the tinfoil. (It shouldn't be much if you did it correctly but it will still have thc and get u buzzed)

  13. Usually let them cool off a bit before eating, otherwise have fun!

Advanced way (Stronger): If you know about how much nutella you should be using per firecracker, I like to go ahead and put the nutella in a small bowl, add a little bit of canola oil to the nutella, not enough to change the consistency but as much as u can before that. It will absorb a lot more thc now :)

From there I mix in the bud really well. Then go ahead an apply to your graham crackers and cook it the exact same way as above!

They don't taste the greatest, but its the fastest, most discrete way to make an at-home edible that I know of. They will kick your ass if you're not careful. Make sure you wait at least two hours after eating one before you consider eating another. Also I recommend eating on an empty stomach. Best way to start the day as I always say... Hope you enjoyed let me know if you like em :D
